scope: targeted initial literature screening, not a systematic review
verification: primary paper metadata/abstracts and selected author repositories; full texts not yet critically reviewed
backend: available web search; skill-specific parallel-cli unavailable

papers.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
papers.note: 500 questions cover information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention. Official repository provides cleaned data; pin dataset revision. Oracle input is diagnostic, not an ordinary retrieval score.

papers.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
papers.note: LoCoMo tests long multi-session conversations. Conversation histories are created through a machine-human pipeline; do not describe this as wholly natural real-user data.

papers.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.note: Creates structured notes with contextual descriptions, keywords and tags, links related memories and updates prior memory representations. Compare against semantic retrieval to isolate value of organization.

papers.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
papers.note: Extracts, consolidates and retrieves salient information; discusses a graph-memory variant. Include ingestion and update calls in resource accounting. Published gains are author-reported under their own evaluation protocol.

papers.title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
papers.note: Uses Graphiti for dynamic temporal knowledge integration. Relevant to conflicting updates and current versus historical facts; a full temporal graph may exceed a short competition implementation window.

papers.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
papers.note: Already included in the initial paper reference bundle. Read the memory management mechanism; replacing simple selection with a named prior method alone does not establish novelty.

papers.title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
papers.note: Separates checks of fact storage, usable evidence retrieval and answer generation from oracle evidence. Source evidence is for diagnosis only; never expose gold evidence to an ordinary tested retriever.

papers.title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
papers.note: 451 curated questions on web-agent state, workflows and failure modes. Very large trajectory histories; first inspect a small development subset and resource requirements.
